Container.Name: Podcast-Extended
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted podcast ad-removal that re-publishes cleaned RSS feeds. Transcribes episodes (Groq, an OpenAI-compatible Whisper server, or local Whisper), detects ads with an LLM (cloud or a local Ollama), and serves an ad-stripped feed your podcast app can subscribe to. This fork (Podcast-Extended) adds bulk feed editing, per-feed episode retention limits, and per-feed episode title filters.
For LAN-only use: leave REQUIRE_AUTH=false and access via http://unraid-ip:port. For internet exposure (reverse proxy / Cloudflare Tunnel): set REQUIRE_AUTH=true, PODLY_ADMIN_USERNAME, PODLY_ADMIN_PASSWORD, PODLY_SECRET_KEY, TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT=1, and PODLY_COOKIE_SECURE=true.
All data, config, and the SQLite database live under the single App Data path you set below.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and the cleaned RSS feeds.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Holds the database, config, logs, and downloaded/processed audio. Keep this on the cache or an SSD-backed share.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the App Data files. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the App Data files. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: GROQ_API_KEY
Config.Description: Groq API key. Works out of the box for both Whisper transcription and (if you do not set a separate LLM key) ad detection. Get one free at https://console.groq.com.

Config.Name: WHISPER_TYPE
Config.Description: Transcription backend: groq | remote | local. Groq is free and fast and needs no GPU on this box. Use 'remote' to point at an OpenAI-compatible Whisper server. (Note: Ollama cannot transcribe audio - use it for the ad-detection LLM via OPENAI_BASE_URL instead.)

Config.Name: LLM_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. API key for the ad-detection LLM. Leave blank to reuse the Groq key. When pointing at a local Ollama, set this to any non-empty value (e.g. 'ollama') since Ollama ignores it.

Config.Name: LLM_MODEL
Config.Description: Optional. Model name for ad detection, e.g. gpt-4o, or an Ollama model you have pulled such as llama3.1 or qwen2.5.

Config.Name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Point the ad-detection LLM at a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server. For a local Ollama on this host use http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:11434/v1 (use the LAN IP, not localhost).

Config.Name: SERVER_THREADS
Config.Description: Number of web server worker threads.

Config.Name: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Leave at -1 to disable GPU (correct for the CPU image). Only change this if you switch to a GPU image variant.

Config.Name: REQUIRE_AUTH
Config.Description: Set to true to require login for the web UI, feeds, and downloads. If true, also set the admin username/password and secret key below.

Config.Name: PODLY_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Admin username (only used when REQUIRE_AUTH=true). Default: podly_admin.

Config.Name: PODLY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password (only used when REQUIRE_AUTH=true). Minimum 12 characters.

Config.Name: PODLY_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Stable random string for signing sessions. Generate with: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(64))". Without this, sessions are lost on restart.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT
Config.Description: Set to 1 when running behind a reverse proxy (Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx, Caddy, NPM). Required for per-client login rate-limiting to work correctly.

Config.Name: PODLY_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set to true when the reverse proxy terminates HTTPS. Marks session cookies as Secure (HTTPS-only).
